# Gateway protocol

Clients connect to `wss://<gateway>/gateway?v=1&encoding=json`. The server sends HELLO with a heartbeat interval of 41250 ms. Sessions can be resumed for 120 s (up to 1000 buffered dispatches). Clients may send 120 frames per 60 s; exceeding it closes with 4008. Objects referenced below (User, Channel, ...) are described in rest.md.

## Frame

### GatewayFrame

Every gateway frame (both directions). `s` and `t` are only set on DISPATCH (op 0).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | `integer` | Gateway opcode (protocol.json gateway.opcodes). |
| `d` | `any` | Opcode payload. |
| `s?` | `?integer` | Sequence number of a dispatch. |
| `t?` | `?string` | Dispatch event name. |

## Opcodes

| Op | Name | Direction | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `DISPATCH` | receive | — | An event was dispatched. `t` is the event name and `s` the sequence number; `d` is described per event. |
| 1 | `HEARTBEAT` | both | `HeartbeatPayload` | Keeps the connection alive. `d` is the last sequence number received, or null. |
| 2 | `IDENTIFY` | send | `IdentifyPayload` | Starts a new session. |
| 3 | `PRESENCE_UPDATE` | send | `PresenceUpdatePayload` | Updates the client's presence. |
| 4 | `VOICE_STATE_UPDATE` | send | `VoiceStateUpdatePayload` | Joins, moves between or leaves voice channels. |
| 6 | `RESUME` | send | `ResumePayload` | Resumes a previous session within the resume window. |
| 7 | `RECONNECT` | receive | — | The client should reconnect and resume. |
| 8 | `REQUEST_GUILD_MEMBERS` | send | `RequestGuildMembersPayload` | Requests guild members; answered with GUILD_MEMBERS_CHUNK dispatches. |
| 9 | `INVALID_SESSION` | receive | `InvalidSessionPayload` | The session is invalid. `d` tells whether it can be resumed. |
| 10 | `HELLO` | receive | `HelloPayload` | Sent immediately after connecting; carries the heartbeat interval. |
| 11 | `HEARTBEAT_ACK` | receive | — | Acknowledges a heartbeat. |
| 20 | `E2EE_ENVELOPE` | both | `E2eeEnvelopePayload` | Ephemeral-mode MLS ciphertext. Client to gateway carries every recipient; gateway to client carries only the receiving device's entry. |
| 21 | `E2EE_ACK` | send | `E2eeAckPayload` | Acknowledges ephemeral messages; the gateway deletes them from this device's inbox. |
| 22 | `P2P_SIGNAL` | both | `P2pSignalPayload` | P2P-mode WebRTC signaling. Relayed only, never persisted. |
| 23 | `VOICE_TELEMETRY` | send | `VoiceTelemetryPayload` | Client voice quality sample, published to discordy.telemetry.v1. |
| 24 | `WATCH_TOGETHER` | both | `WatchTogetherPayload` | Watch Together playback synchronisation. |
| 25 | `CALL_DECLINE` | send | `CallDeclinePayload` | Declines the DM call ringing in a channel. The caller's call stops ringing for this user. |

## Close codes

| Code | Name | Description | Reconnect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4000 | `UNKNOWN_ERROR` | Unknown error. | yes |
| 4001 | `UNKNOWN_OPCODE` | An invalid opcode or payload for an opcode was sent. | yes |
| 4002 | `DECODE_ERROR` | An invalid payload was sent. | yes |
| 4003 | `NOT_AUTHENTICATED` | A payload was sent before identifying. | yes |
| 4004 | `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` | The token in IDENTIFY was invalid. | no |
| 4005 | `ALREADY_AUTHENTICATED` | More than one IDENTIFY was sent. | yes |
| 4007 | `INVALID_SEQ` | The sequence sent when resuming was invalid. | yes |
| 4008 | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 120 payloads were sent within 60 seconds. | yes |
| 4009 | `SESSION_TIMED_OUT` | The session timed out. | yes |
| 4013 | `INVALID_INTENTS` | An invalid intent bitfield was sent. | no |
| 4014 | `DISALLOWED_INTENTS` | A privileged intent was requested that the application is not approved for. | no |

## Intents

Discord bit values. User sessions implicitly receive every intent; privileged intents require approval for bots.

| Bit | Value | Name | Privileged | Events |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 << 0 | 1 | `GUILDS` | no | GUILD_CREATE, GUILD_UPDATE, GUILD_DELETE, GUILD_ROLE_CREATE, GUILD_ROLE_UPDATE, GUILD_ROLE_DELETE, CHANNEL_CREATE, CHANNEL_UPDATE, CHANNEL_DELETE, CHANNEL_PINS_UPDATE, THREAD_CREATE, THREAD_UPDATE, THREAD_DELETE |
| 1 << 1 | 2 | `GUILD_MEMBERS` | yes | GUILD_MEMBER_ADD, GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE, GUILD_MEMBER_REMOVE |
| 1 << 2 | 4 | `GUILD_MODERATION` | no | AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_CREATE, GUILD_BAN_ADD, GUILD_BAN_REMOVE |
| 1 << 3 | 8 | `GUILD_EMOJIS` (Discord: `GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`) | no | GUILD_EMOJIS_UPDATE |
| 1 << 4 | 16 | `GUILD_INTEGRATIONS` | no | — |
| 1 << 5 | 32 | `GUILD_WEBHOOKS` | no | — |
| 1 << 6 | 64 | `GUILD_INVITES` | no | INVITE_CREATE, INVITE_DELETE |
| 1 << 7 | 128 | `GUILD_VOICE_STATES` | no | VOICE_STATE_UPDATE |
| 1 << 8 | 256 | `GUILD_PRESENCES` | yes | PRESENCE_UPDATE |
| 1 << 9 | 512 | `GUILD_MESSAGES` | no | MESSAGE_CREATE, MESSAGE_UPDATE, MESSAGE_DELETE, MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK |
| 1 << 10 | 1024 | `GUILD_MESSAGE_REACTIONS` | no | MESSAGE_REACTION_ADD, MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE, MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE_ALL |
| 1 << 11 | 2048 | `GUILD_MESSAGE_TYPING` | no | TYPING_START |
| 1 << 12 | 4096 | `DIRECT_MESSAGES` | no | MESSAGE_CREATE, MESSAGE_UPDATE, MESSAGE_DELETE, CHANNEL_PINS_UPDATE |
| 1 << 13 | 8192 | `DIRECT_MESSAGE_REACTIONS` | no | MESSAGE_REACTION_ADD, MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE, MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE_ALL |
| 1 << 14 | 16384 | `DIRECT_MESSAGE_TYPING` | no | TYPING_START |
| 1 << 15 | 32768 | `MESSAGE_CONTENT` | yes | — |
